title: AI Document Chat
summary: Upload documents and chat with them. Answers stream in and cite the passages they came from.
description:
Built from scratch to show the kind of product I led the frontend for at a law firm, using public sample documents.

- Workspaces of documents that are parsed, chunked and indexed.
- Streaming answers with clickable citations and conversation history.
- Sign-in, accessible keyboard-first chat UI, and a demo mode that works without an API key.
